newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Cos made strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Cos made strong buy.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said on Thursday it started coverage of United Cos with a strong buy rating and a 12-month price target of $32 per share.
-- Analyst Katrina Blecher said in a research note the company's valuation was compelling relative to its peer group.
-- She said her 1997 earnings estimate was $3.00 per share and her 1998 earnings estimate was $3.60 per share.
-- "We estimate that earnings per share will rise 20 percent in each of the next two years," she said. "At the current price, the shares trade at 65 percent discount to 1997's growth rate."
-- United Cos' shares were up 1-3/8 at 22-1/4.
